title: Bound the entropy of the actual path rather than its mean
statement: For a nonnegative fixed equilibrium e-value E with expectation<=1 under EVERY admitted stationary reversible hidden model,the solo proof reports E_P[exp(-Sigma_N/2)E]<=1 and Pr{Sigma_N>=2log(alpha E)}>=1-alpha. A symmetric geometric-mean subkernel completed by self-loops supplies the reference. The full CTMC-path transfer pays coarsening and the actual physical-source interpretation. Sigma_N may be negative;retain negative lower endpoints or abstain rather than clamp to zero. This is total trajectory entropy with boundary term,not medium heat alone or a uniformly substantial stationary mean-rate certificate.
